project_type: Python FastAPI backend with React frontend (monorepo)
build_system: pip with requirements.txt, Node.js frontend with npm
test_framework: pytest with anyio marker, conftest.py fixtures with httpx AsyncClient
verification_instructions: Run pytest on backend tests, verify topic_matcher and chat tests pass
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Python 3.11 available. No Docker daemon needed for validation.
key_patterns: ChatService is a static-method-based class in chat_service.py. TopicMatcher is a singleton in topic_matcher.py. Tests use unittest.mock patches. SSE streaming uses 'content' field (not 'text'). Generic queries skip RAG via is_generic_query regex pattern.
directory_structure: apps/backend/ - FastAPI backend with app/services/ai/ for AI logic, app/api/v1/ for endpoints, tests/ for tests. apps/frontend/ - React frontend.
